megan_csm: Quick heads-up — Brookline Health usage is down ~48% week-over-week, onboarding stalled after QBR. Noticed spike in procurement questions and a competitive eval in progress.

derek_am: Ack. Do we have session-level numbers or specific feature drop-offs?

megan_csm: Top-level: API calls for summarization dropped the most, embeddings steady. They paused the automated ingest job last Thursday. I pinged Jordan (Head of AI) but he left last week — new PM (Claire) is getting looped in.

sophie_se: Linking dashboard and recent audit: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/brookline-health -> filter last_30d. Quick snippet: `sum(api_calls) by day` shows the cliff starting 2024-02-08.

eli_eng: Possible causes: ingest job config mismatch after data schema change OR they hit rate limit + backoff. Any 429s in logs?

megan_csm: No 429 spikes in our logs, but they did reduce concurrency on their side. Procurement also asked for a competitor feature comparison yesterday (sent a slide deck).

derek_am: Risk tier: medium-high. Renewal in 10 weeks. Recommend: 1) immediate 30-min triage with Claire + eng support, 2) propose a 2-week complimentary spike on Dedicated (no-commit) to show throughput gains, 3) share usage and cost breakdown with CFO.

megan_csm: Agreed. Who can join the triage tomorrow AM (PST)? Need someone who can quickly look at ingest job and suggest config tweaks.

eli_eng: I can join. Will prep a short runbook: `ingest -> batching -> kv-cache warmup` checks.

sophie_se: I can surface the last 3 deploys and recent model variants they were on. Also will prepare an export of prompt sets that saw the biggest delta.

megan_csm: Perfect. @derek_am can you draft the invite + brief (1-pager) to send to Claire + procurement? I'll include the renewal playbook and a tailored ROI snippet.

derek_am: On it. Draft done by EOD and will share here for edits.

megan_csm: One ask: let's avoid sounding like a hard sell. Focus: unblock onboarding, show value, offer safe pilot. If competitive features are purely model-capability driven, we'll propose an eval with tuned configs first.

eli_eng: Noted. Also propose enabling verbose latency tracing during the pilot so we can prove p99 improvements.

oncall-bot: Deployment notice: Dedicated pool quota updated for trial accounts at 2024-02-15 03:12 UTC.

megan_csm: Thanks — that quota change will let us offer the 2-week spike without manual approvals. I'll schedule triage for tomorrow 10:30am PST and loop in Claire + procurement. Will post invite + pre-read here in ~1h. :thumbsup:

sophie_se: Great. I'll attach the dashboard snapshots to the invite.

megan_csm: Closing loop — goal for triage: get ingest running, establish quick wins, and confirm experiment plan to keep them from switching. If anyone flags legal or billing friction, escalate to me immediately.

derek_am: Got it.

eli_eng: See you tomorrow. I'll bring the runbook and a couple config patches to test live.

megan_csm: Thanks team.
